title: cacalia puberula
intro: Cacalia puberula, commonly known as the hairy toothwort or yellow flowers toothwort, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cacalia puberula are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may help to modulate the immune system and reduce oxidative stress. Further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of Cacalia puberula for medicinal use, but it may have potential in the prevention and treatment of various diseases.
